name: Profit.co MCP
description:
Connect Profit.co to Claude and manage your entire strategy execution process without leaving your conversation. The Profit.co connector provides live, secure access to your workspace, allowing you to create objectives, define and track key results, submit check-ins, manage tasks, and monitor OKR progress using simple natural language commands.

Once connected, Claude can help you create objectives at the company, team, or individual level, add measurable key results, update progress through check-ins, and create or manage tasks with due dates, priorities, statuses, and comments. It can also provide visibility into your current OKRs, identify key results that are behind schedule, and highlight overdue, blocked, or pending actions that require attention.

Authentication is secured through OAuth 2.0, and all access follows the permissions already configured in Profit.co. Private OKRs remain private, and your data continues to reside within Profit.co’s secure infrastructure. The connector is available on Claude.ai (web and mobile), Claude Desktop, and Claude Code, and works with all Profit.co plans.

Whether you want to review progress, create new objectives, update key results, manage tasks, or stay on top of pending work, the Profit.co connector enables you to do it directly from your Claude conversation, eliminating the need to switch between applications and helping you stay focused on execution.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Profit.co MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Profit.co MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://integrations.profit.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Profit.co MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Profit.co MCP provides these MCP tools: get_checkin_preview, get_key_result_creation_preview, get_my_okrs, get_objective_creation_preview, get_task_creation_preview, get_task_update_preview, get_tasks_for_update, get_welcome_message, and list_pending_actions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Profit.co MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Profit.co MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Profit.co MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Profit.co MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Profit.co MCP is developed by Profit Apps Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
